# scripts/deploy/verifyCompany/ — the Deploy Verification company

**Purpose:** production's post-deploy verification (`scripts/verify-deploy.sh`, run by `deploy.sh`, `restart-colours.sh`
and `cutover.sh`) runs the 24 non-dev-only golden-path specs in a hidden company of its own instead of the production Demo
company. The specs find-or-create `0GP-Golden-*` masters, post invoices, payments, journals, depreciation and a payroll
run, and create the `0GP Golden Migration Sandbox` company; none of that now lands in Demo, which is Willie's and the
prospects' company.

**Files:** `config.ts` (names, the verify login's address, argument and input guards), `password.ts` (which password a run
uses), `envFile.ts` (create-or-update the two `E2E_VERIFY_*` keys, 0600), `provisionDb.ts` (users row, company, fiscal
years, one transaction), `seedVerifyCompany.ts` (seed through the running app, per-block idempotent). CLI:
`scripts/deploy/provision-verify-company.ts`; production wrapper `scripts/deploy/provision-verify-company.sh`.
Tests: `tests/unit/ci/verifyCompany*.test.ts`, `tests/unit/scripts/verifyDeployCredentials.test.ts`,
`provisionVerifyCompanyWrapper.test.ts`, `tests/integration/deploy-verify-company.int.test.ts`.

**Contract:**
- Login `deploy-verify@isaflow.dev` (`.dev`, like `golden-slot-n@isaflow.dev`: never a mailbox), GoTrue user created through
  the admin API (email confirmed, no MFA, random password never printed), `users` row role `accountant`, owner and sole
  member of the company `Deploy Verification` (`companies.is_demo = true`: out of platform metrics, MRR, landing and trial
  counts; shown "internal" in the admin console; invisible in every other user's company switcher).
- The company is made by `create_company_with_owner` (as `seed-demo.sql` and the app's own new-company call do), then
  financial years for 2025-06, 2026-06, 2027-01, 2027-06 and the run's date are generated (`fiscal_year_ensure` +
  `fiscal_periods_generate`): the specs post 2026-01..2027-02, the payroll sandbox month is 2027-02. Rerun any later day and
  the year holding that day is added; periods that exist are untouched.
- Seed (`seedVerifyCompany.ts`) reuses `scripts/ci/golden-hosted/seed-demo-app.ts`'s seeders (its `Client`, `seedPeople`,
  `seedSuppliersAndInvoices`, `seedJournals`, `seedBankRows`, `seed-golden-fixtures.ts`) with small counts, plus one original budget
  version for the current year (the two budget specs skip a company without one): through the app as the verify user, never by table writes. A block with all its marker records is skipped, with none is made, with some is refused.
  Before seeding the app must put the verify user in the company this run provisioned, which proves it is backed by the
  database named on the command line.
- Idempotent and additive: nothing that exists is updated (the one exception is the two `user_preferences` keys, moved only
  the way the app moves them). `E2E_VERIFY_EMAIL`/`E2E_VERIFY_PASSWORD` are written LAST, after the company passes
  `slotProblems`, so a deploy never reads a half-provisioned company. If the login exists and the file holds no password
  (a run that died before the write), `--reset-password` sets a new one.
- Nothing is defaulted: the owner database url, GoTrue url and service key come from `VERIFY_COMPANY_DATABASE_URL`,
  `GOTRUE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` (environment, never argv); `--expect-database`, `--base-url`, `--env-file` are
  required, and `current_database()` must equal `--expect-database`. The `.sh` wrapper resolves them the way `deploy.sh` does
  (`owner_database_url_for`: `/etc/isaflow/owner.env`, else `/home/velo/isaflow/.env.local`; GoTrue from the latter).
  `--dry-run` runs the database step in a rolled-back transaction, reads GoTrue, and writes nothing.
- verify-deploy.sh: `E2E_VERIFY_*` set (exported, or in the creds file): `E2E_ADMIN_*` becomes the verify pair,
  `E2E_APPROVER_*` is dropped, z22 gets `GOLDEN_PLATFORM_ADMIN_*` (or the old `E2E_ADMIN_*` pair); one half alone, or no platform
  admin anywhere, fails. Neither set: unchanged, plus one `deploy checks ran on the Demo company` line.

**Rules:** the dev slot guards (`isaflow_dev`, `601d000g` ids) are not loosened for this; the wrapper is the only thing that
reads production's files. Do not give the verify user a second company by hand: the specs add their own sandboxes to it, and
login opens the default (first) one, which must stay `Deploy Verification`.
